source: MVP 30-word subset of the Kaggle asl-signs 250-word vocabulary.
note: Index = training label (0-29), i.e. position in the `words` array. All 30 verified present in s3://asl-mvp-dataset/preprocessed/by_word/. The training script filters splits/split_manifest.parquet to these words and re-maps to 0-29 via word_to_index below. The no-sign/background class, when added (Phase 6), becomes index 30.
